services.title: Tree lopping & pruning
services.long: Lopping and pruning of native and introduced trees and shrubs, including thinning heavy canopy and removing overhanging branches.

services.title: Tree felling & removal
services.long: Complete tree removal and clearing for small and large trees, using a spider lift or harness system so tight spots aren't a problem.

services.title: Stump grinding
services.long: Stump removal with a commercial stump grinder, leaving the ground level and ready to use.

services.title: Mulching & green waste
services.short: Chip it, leave it or take it.
services.long: Large branches mulched and chipped on site, with the mulch left for your garden or taken away, plus garden waste removal.

services.title: Spider lift hire
services.long: Cherry picker (spider lift) hire for tight or steep worksites where a truck can't get in.

services.title: Firewood, mulch & soil
services.long: Sustainable firewood in several blends including red gum and blue gum, split and delivered, plus mulch and soil supply.
